lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Y8O16 (reduced formula SrY4O8) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with 26 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Y centers as octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sr adopts an eight-vertex coordination polyhedron. O centers show fourfold geometric coordination. Corner-sharing is observed between Y octahedra and between Sr and Y polyhedra, with additional corner- and edge-sharing between Sr polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 26 sites.
